findings.evidence: `rg -n 'theorem (prod|pi)_(one|mul)' TauCeti/Topology/Homotopy/HomotopyGroup/Product.lean` has no hits; lines 130 and 220 expose the constructors, while lines 199 and 274 introduce the multiplicative equivalences.
findings.fix: Add appropriately `[simp]`-annotated `prod_one`, `prod_mul`, `pi_one`, and `pi_mul` lemmas (derivable from `prodMulEquiv.symm` and `piMulEquiv.symm`), or keep the raw constructors non-public if only the equivalences are intended as API.
findings.issue: Public `HomotopyGroup.prod` and `HomotopyGroup.pi` have no positive-dimensional `*_one` or `*_mul` characteristic lemmas, so simplification cannot expose that these coordinatewise constructors preserve the group operation.

summary: The public coordinatewise constructors lack the algebraic interaction lemmas needed to use them as the inverses of the multiplicative equivalences.
